text_block_list.text:
As I head towards the train station on my
day off, I suddenly hear a
familiar voice.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
All right, time to put my super-duper
secret plan into action!
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара
choice_data_list: Oh? And what would that be?

text_block_list.text:
Well, you see... Wait! What are you doing
here?!
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text:
Oh, yeah? Me too! Ah, but this is all a part
of my super-duper secret
plan, so that's all
I'm telling you!
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text:
Aaanyway, I better get going! See you
later!
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text:
Хару Урара dashes away before I can say
another word. A mix of
curiosity and
concern compels me to follow her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hm... That magazine said it should be
around here...
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text:
As she wanders around aimlessly, one of
the nearby shopkeepers
approaches her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Lookin' for somethin' special, are we?
text_block_list.name: Shady Shopkeeper

text_block_list.text:
Yup! I'm trying to find the shoe store
around here! Do you know
where it is?
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text:
Forget about that store! I've got just the
shoes for you, riiight here.
text_block_list.name: Shady Shopkeeper

text_block_list.text:
No, thank you! I'm not looking for just any
shoes. I need the kind that
give you super
speed!
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text:
Well, what a co-inky-dink! These just so
happen to be the
world-renowned Super
Speed Sneakers! How about I give you a
deal
on them?
text_block_list.name: Shady Shopkeeper

text_block_list.text:
Urgh... I have juuust enough to buy them,
but... Are you SURE they'll
make me
faster?
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text:
Positive! First place is as good as yours
with these babies on your
feet!
text_block_list.name: Shady Shopkeeper

text_block_list.text:
Really truly?! Well... they are a bit
expensive, but if they'll make me
faster—
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text: Тренер?!
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text:
What?! All that stuff about making me
faster was a lie?! But he said
first place was
as good as mine!
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text:
No kidding... And now my super-duper
secret plan to get faster is
down the drain!
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара
choice_data_list: How were you going to do that?

text_block_list.text:
With shoes that make me extra fast, of
course!
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара
choice_data_list: Only practice can increase your speed.

text_block_list.text:
I-I'm not trying to skip out on any
training... I just want to get faster!
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text:
Remember those nice things the reporter
said about you? That made
me really
happy.
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text:
If that's the kind of stuff she says NOW,
imagine what people would
say about you
if I WON!
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text:
I figured if I could find a way to win first
place faster, I could surprise
you and
everyone else!
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text:
I'd love to win a race, and if that means
everyone will praise you, I'd
love it even
more!
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text:
She's already putting in the work, but Haru
Urara still wants more. As
a trainer, I'm in
awe of her dedication.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: Well, it's good to be motivated!

text_block_list.text:
Right?! Ehehe, I'm glad you feel that way.
I'll make sure to find the
right shoes—
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара
choice_data_list: But we need to do this together.

text_block_list.text: Together?
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара
choice_data_list: Let's find a way to win... together.

text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Yeah, you're right! I shoulda gone
to you right away!
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text:
Well, looks like I'll need to give
tomorrow's training some
extra-special
effort! See you then!
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text:
Хару Урара excitedly runs back to Tracen
Academy. With a better
understanding of
her motivations, I feel my desire to help
her win
growing even stronger.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
